subject.title: perf: use a focused OpenClaw prepack profile for diagnostics

question: Should Kova adopt a distinct focused OpenClaw prepack profile for diagnostics, and what minimum runtime assets and scenarios must remain release-representative?
rationale: The request introduces a packaging contract rather than correcting an established failure; choosing the omission boundary trades diagnostic speed against confidence in release-shaped behavior.

options.title: Specify and validate a focused profile
options.body: Define the retained assets, supported scenarios, baseline metrics, and required fresh-install plus diagnostic proof before implementing a narrow profile.

options.title: Keep the existing release-shaped package path
options.body: Retain the broader prepack workflow until a measurable diagnostic bottleneck and safe omission boundary are demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Specify and validate a focused profile
recommendation.body: Define the retained assets, supported scenarios, baseline metrics, and required fresh-install plus diagnostic proof before implementing a narrow profile.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned member author and the recent contributor to adjacent Kova diagnostics-performance work.
